title: Duplexer Module - Band 66 (AWS) for Public Safety Band Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Sarah Okonkwo

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Duplexer Module filter targeting Band 66 (AWS) for Public Safety Band Filter. The filter is designed on Langasite substrate with a target center frequency of 2312.6 MHz and bandwidth of 358.6 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the Public Safety Band Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Duplexer Module
- Frequency Band: Band 66 (AWS)
- Application: Public Safety Band Filter
- Substrate: Langasite
- Package: Flip-Chip BGA
- Design Tool: Ansys HFSS 2024R1
- Design Center: Newbury Park Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Duplexer Module design targeting Band 66 (AWS). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       2312.6 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       358.6 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 1.7 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 22.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 52.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 32.0 dB
Q Factor:               1162
Temperature Coefficient:-19.8 ppm/°C
Die Size:               1.2 x 2.0 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   4
Electrode Material:     Mo/Al
Passivation:            SiO2/Si3N4 stack
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open Ansys HFSS 2024R1 and load the Duplexer Module template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Langasite with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 2312.6 MHz, BW 358.6 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 1.7 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (Flip-Chip BGA).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, Langasite).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Keysight N9041B UXA.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 6938 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 1.7 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 22.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 538 MHz offset >= 52.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 10 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 5.7 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +25 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 91%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-12-17
Devices Tested:         26
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.41 dB
Return Loss (meas):     24.5 dB
Rejection (meas):       54.5 dB
Isolation (meas):       37.3 dB
Q Factor (meas):        1162
Group Delay Variation:  3.5 ns
Power Handling:         +29 dBm
Die Yield:              98.1%

Result Classification:  NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Duplexer Module design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 66 (AWS).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Temperature stability was within specification across full range.
e) Batch-to-batch reproducibility confirmed over 3 wafer lots.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Review near-band rejection margin for worst-case temperature.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Schedule follow-up measurement after design tweak.
